event_corrections.source: Stream freezes ~8507.9-8512.7 (pieces hang mid-air; corr/fr/g3/b101a.png). nextcount p2: only Z (spawn 8505.97) and I (8514.03) spawn in the window. p2 score jumps: 8505.33 +600 (REN2), 8513.37 +750 (Z single REN3), 8514.20 +3028 (TETRIS REN4 = 2400+600), 8515.23 next clear. Frames 8514.1-8514.9 show one vertical I clearing 4 garbage rows with TETRIS banner and REN continuing to 5 (corr/fr/g3/b101b.png). So the 8512.93 single (no spawn, no score jump) and the 8514.03 triple are phantoms, and the BREAK at 8514.07 is wrong (REN continues). Pieces cell not edited: chain_games pieces (140) does not equal the event count (133) here, so the effect on pieces is unclear; if pieces follow events it should drop by 2.

corr/fr/g3/b107.png: T locks at ~8781.5 into the hole left of the well; board unchanged (no row cleared); banner is 'Mini T-SPIN' with no 'Single'; score +300 at 8781.63 (zero-line mini). Next clear 8783.03 is +300 (REN starts fresh), then +450..+2250 for the 14 chain singles 8782.5-8794.13, so the singles are right and the -2622 residual is this phantom line.

Stream freeze 8851.6-8855.9 (no score change for either player). nextcount p1: spawns 8848.53, 8849.63, 8850.67, 8851.63, 8856.77, 8857.67, 8858.93; none at 8851.8. Score jumps after the 8847.7 quad: +450, +1200(double), +750, +900, +1050, +1200, +1350 = 7 clears vs chain's 8 (singles at 8851.63 and 8851.8 both). The 8851.63 piece clears at 8856.00 (+900 REN4); 8851.8 is a duplicate.

corr/fr/g3/b118.png: S locks at ~9479.5 and clears one (garbage) row; score +2250 at 9479.60 = single REN13 (300+1950). The one TETRIS is the I at ~9480.3 (+4500 = 2400+2100 REN14), which is the chain's 9480.43 quad. Explains the -3126 residual.

Added after the skeptic's aside, checked by the coordinator: O spawns 8514.94 and is held (HOLD shows O at 8515.15), the S drops into the well and two rows flash at 8515.22 (corr/fr/me/b101c.png). p2 score +1650 at 8515.23 = double 900 + REN5 750; a single would be 1050. Rows cleared are the red stack rows above the garbage, so gc 0.
